evidence.quote: press the action button and then it engages all the Constructors that are built-in as far as engaging the Pancake Router it automatically buys and sells for you

evidence.observation: The speaker claims the bot transfers profit to the user's wallet.
evidence.quote: The front-run bot will transfer the profit back to your wallet.

evidence.observation: The speaker expressly presents front-running retail traders as the trading mechanism.
evidence.quote: so that way it will front run at the at the retail investors that come in, so you'll only be competing with other bots on the mempool.

evidence.observation: The speaker claims an automatic sale within one minute, with 90% returned to the wallet and 10% retained in the purported protocol.
evidence.quote: It will automatically sell within 1 minute and then from there it will take 90%. It will automatically transit it back to your wallet, the remaining 10% will stay within the frontrunner protocol

evidence.observation: The speaker claims that repeated cycles using a larger amount could yield upwards of 100 BNB a day.
evidence.quote: You can run this cycle multiple times a day, so can have upwards of 100 BNB a day if you use a larger amount than what I started with.

evidence.observation: The description warns of trading losses and denies a guaranteed outcome, in tension with the title.
evidence.quote: Trading cryptocurrencies poses considerable risk of loss. The speaker does not guarantee any particular outcome.

evidence.observation: Remix shows a Deploy & Run Transactions panel with a Deploy control and a message that no contract instances are available in that sampled view.
A MetaMask send form is open over Remix, with an amount field and a Next button; this frame does not show a completed transfer.
Remix shows a deployed-contract section with callable controls, including a red Action button.
The speaker reports past personal gains of several hundred BNB over recent weeks.
evidence.quote: I've had really good luck with this in the last few weeks I've made several hundred BNB
